title: Prediction of Response to Neoadjuvant Therapy in Rectal Cancer
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether 18F-FDG-PET-CT and texture analysis of MRI performed 9 weeks after Neoadjuvant Chemo-radiotherapy in patients with locally advanced rectal cancer has the ability to identify patients with Complete Response.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with biopsy-proven confirmed rectal cancer
* MRI stage: T3/T4 and/or N1/N0.
* No contraindication to MRI and PET-CT.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Contraindication to MRI and/or PET-CT.
* Inability to consent.
* Severe claustrophobia.
* Distant metastases.
* Synchronous tumour.
